authority.rule: Drive owns engineering/evidence content. Git mirrors exact row values for typed implementation, validation and review; physical claims remain at their recorded evidence ceiling.

records.Mechanism: mutual capacitance/inductance + shared return
records.Higher-Order Trigger: pair model residual or dense 3+ routes
records.Design Rule: route return path with signal; preserve impedance/separation

records.Mechanism: surface current chooses lowest impedance path
records.Design Rule: do not route critical signals across reference discontinuity

records.Mechanism: fringing capacitance to nearby conductors
records.Higher-Order Trigger: high impedance nodes or dense stacks
records.Design Rule: extract C matrix for dense geometry

records.Mechanism: changing flux induces voltage in loops
records.Design Rule: minimize unintended loop area; define return path

records.Mechanism: L and C form resonant modes
records.Design Rule: make every resonance intentional or damped

records.Mechanism: near-field/radiative/acoustic/magnetic mode interaction
records.Design Rule: measure coupled modes, not isolated-only performance

records.Mechanism: body dielectric/conductor changes current/field distribution
records.Design Rule: validate antenna on final body/material state

records.Mechanism: lossy dielectric body perturbs antenna and absorbs field
records.Design Rule: only use measurable EM exposure/performance targets
records.Validation Test: VNA + calibrated field/SAR method as applicable

records.Mechanism: collector intercepts measured incident RF spectrum
records.Design Rule: energy conservation and site spectrum are hard gates

records.Mechanism: switch-node dv/dt and di/dt couple through fields/returns
records.Design Rule: separate noisy power loops from sensitive nodes

records.Mechanism: conduction/switch loss produces localized heat
records.Design Rule: close electrical and thermal models iteratively

records.Mechanism: junction temperature shifts efficiency/spectrum/lifetime
records.Design Rule: junction thermal path is part of optical design

records.Mechanism: ohmic/reaction/entropy heat changes cell state
records.Design Rule: cell-to-cell propagation and vent paths modeled separately
records.Validation Test: cycling + calorimetry + abuse per cell class

records.Mechanism: compression/swelling/impact affect separator/interfaces
records.Design Rule: storage region never carries structural load by assumption

records.Mechanism: body deformation strains buried conductors/joints
records.Design Rule: route fragile conductors near neutral axis or strain-relieved

records.Mechanism: surface deflection changes alignment/path/wavefront
records.Design Rule: optical datum tied to structural/metrology datum

records.Mechanism: stress/temp changes dimensions/material properties
records.Design Rule: mounting condition is part of resonator twin

records.Mechanism: actuator changes state measured by sensor
records.Design Rule: real-time safety/control stays deterministic/local

records.Mechanism: heater deliberately perturbs temperature/flow/gas response
records.Design Rule: calibration includes heater state and ambient

records.Mechanism: shared environment/ground/field creates correlated errors
records.Design Rule: redundancy requires independent failure paths

records.Mechanism: actuator field sensed by Hall/MR/magnetometer
records.Design Rule: calibrate with actuator state; separate if sensing external field

records.Mechanism: reaction torque and modal excitation travel through mounts
records.Design Rule: mount design includes system modes

records.Mechanism: drive waveform and back-EMF couple with inverter/current loops
records.Design Rule: model drive, motor and bus as one switching system

records.Mechanism: internal/external pressure loads walls and seals
records.Design Rule: pressure boundary and structural load share geometry authority

records.Mechanism: fluid presence changes insulation/conductivity/corrosion
records.Design Rule: wet and high-voltage zones require hard separation

records.Mechanism: moving fluid transports heat
records.Higher-Order Trigger: phase change or strongly temp-dependent properties
records.Design Rule: optimize thermal and pressure metrics together

records.Mechanism: diffusion/convection sets analyte delivery to sensor
records.Higher-Order Trigger: reaction consumes analyte or multiple species
records.Design Rule: sensor calibration includes transport geometry

records.Mechanism: radiance propagates through optics/medium
records.Design Rule: model stray paths, not only nominal ray

records.Mechanism: temperature changes index/geometry/emission
records.Design Rule: include T field in optical model when sensitivity matters

records.Mechanism: shell modes radiate/receive sound
records.Design Rule: use measured boundary damping where possible

records.Mechanism: ultrasound propagates through gas/liquid/channel
records.Design Rule: medium state belongs in transducer calibration

records.Mechanism: strain creates charge / field creates strain
records.Design Rule: poling/orientation and bond are explicit state

records.Mechanism: temperature gradient and current transport heat/electric energy
records.Design Rule: include contact R and thermal interfaces

records.Mechanism: reaction state changes volume and stress
records.Design Rule: mechanical state is part of cell twin

records.Mechanism: tabs/collectors distribute current into active regions
records.Design Rule: collector path included in cell model

records.Mechanism: package/trace L,C,R alters switching/RF behavior
records.Design Rule: package is not ideal node in high-speed/power analysis

records.Mechanism: CTE/load bends die/package/interconnect
records.Design Rule: avoid fragile package in high-strain zones

records.Mechanism: photons generate carriers or carrier recombination emits photons
records.Design Rule: use device-specific authoritative model

records.Mechanism: protection only works if path inductance/ground is controlled
records.Design Rule: place protection physically at entry/target path

records.Mechanism: enclosure/spacing contains heat, arc, fragments or vent products
records.Design Rule: certified protection assemblies not replaced by geometry inference

records.Mechanism: interfaces transfer load/motion with friction/clearance
records.Design Rule: surface/clearance are state variables

records.Mechanism: moving joints/cables cyclically strain conductors
records.Design Rule: dynamic route has explicit bend/twist envelope

records.Mechanism: fluid/chemical changes ɛ,σ,μ or geometry in sensing region
records.Design Rule: calibrate against actual medium and temperature

records.Mechanism: recovered feed changes conductivity/dielectric/mechanical behavior
records.Design Rule: material passport and application coupon precede use

records.Mechanism: recycled filler/polymer/mineral alters strength/thermal/weather behavior
records.Design Rule: ecological benefit cannot waive performance/contamination test

records.Mechanism: later print/cure/fusion can damage prior component
records.Design Rule: future thermal/chemical budget follows every embedded component

records.Mechanism: tool capability limits actual field geometry
records.Design Rule: Raphael search bounded by measured process capability

records.Mechanism: fine functional region contributes effective bulk behavior
records.Design Rule: macro effective property never replaces local failure check

records.Mechanism: global loads/environment drive fine local states
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: wrong uniform boundary misses local peak
records.Design Rule: feed measured/validated boundary history to micro model

records.Mechanism: duplicate elements share field/heat/power/material/process
records.Design Rule: redundancy must be physically and logically independent enough for stated fault

records.Mechanism: digital identity maps exact geometry/material/revision/test state
records.Design Rule: no action from unresolved identity/config mismatch

records.Mechanism: candidate geometry must share objective/material/environment and be evaluated by standard physics
records.Potential Useful Coupling: discover better geometry if evidence supports
records.Higher-Order Trigger: candidate wins only in unvalidated proxy
records.Design Rule: baseline always retained in Pareto set until disproven

records.Mechanism: harvested power must match duty cycle/storage/converter losses
records.Higher-Order Trigger: predicted long-term balance lacks site data
records.Design Rule: integrate measured energy over time; include standby/conversion/storage loss

records.Mechanism: coating electrical/optical/sensor layers experience substrate strain/water/UV/abrasion
records.Design Rule: functional performance and civil safety/weathering tested together

records.Mechanism: nearby bodies/weather alter fields/optics
records.Design Rule: only infer variables validated by calibration; avoid health/biological inference

records.Mechanism: material/process from one function contaminates adjacent function
records.Design Rule: material provenance and cleaning/segregation state carried in build graph

records.Mechanism: different CTE/stiffness create cyclic interface stress
records.Potential Useful Coupling: preload or bimetal function if designed
records.Design Rule: CTE and cure history are explicit for bonded stacks

records.Mechanism: insulators reduce electrical risk but can impede heat removal
records.Design Rule: optimize breakdown and Rth as separate hard metrics

records.Mechanism: buried integration reduces joints but can block inspection/repair
records.Design Rule: seed/active/high-value components default to serviceable islands until evidence supports burial

records.Mechanism: all pairwise/higher-order fields overlap in one geometry/time state
records.Potential Useful Coupling: new integrated functions discovered from verified overlaps
records.Higher-Order Trigger: system residual not explained by validated pair models
records.Design Rule: do not claim 'complete' until unclosed IDs/fields/interactions are explicit
records.Mitigation / Control: retain unknowns;promote higher-order only on residual
records.Notes: This is the convergence edge between the atlas and novel/frontier applications.

records.Mechanism: adjacent gain/filter/mixer/PA blocks load one another through ports, grounds, fields and supply
records.Geometry Variables: block spacing; line Z/length; cavity/ground partitions; supply routes
records.State Variables: S-parameters; noise; spectra; phase; V/I; T
records.Potential Useful Coupling: intentional matched cascade and shared filter/antenna functions
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: oscillation; desense; LO leakage; intermodulation; PA-to-LNA coupling
records.Design Rule: close RF cascade and stability before geometric integration benefit claims
records.Mitigation / Control: shield partitions; filtering; return control; sequencing; physical separation

records.Mechanism: switching current circulates through finite inductance/resistance/capacitance
records.Geometry Variables: switch-capacitor distance; bus overlap; return path; via field
records.State Variables: di/dt; dv/dt; V/I; E/H; T; state
records.Potential Useful Coupling: laminated bus can reduce parasitic and volume
records.Higher-Order Trigger: residual ringing/EMI after extracted pair model
records.Design Rule: model source-switch-capacitor-return as one closed 3D loop

records.Mechanism: charge/discharge current and balancing change cell temperature/voltage/state estimates
records.Geometry Variables: sense placement; bus R; cell spacing; thermal path; pack topology
records.State Variables: V/I; SOC/SOH proxy; T; cell imbalance; t
records.Potential Useful Coupling: thermal/sense geometry can improve estimation and balancing
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: sense error; local heating; unequal current; thermal runaway propagation
records.Higher-Order Trigger: cell divergence not explained by calibrated model
records.Design Rule: Kelvin/sense and thermal paths must be separate from high-current drops

records.Mechanism: geometry/material transition adds parasitic L/C/R and reflection
records.Geometry Variables: pad/via/taper; pin; ground return; dielectric; contact overlap
records.State Variables: S-parameters; contact R; E/H; T; force
records.Potential Useful Coupling: optimized transition can preserve controlled impedance and serviceability
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: reflection; crosstalk; heating; PIM; contact wear
records.Design Rule: every detachable interface gets explicit transition model and test port
records.Mitigation / Control: taper/ground vias; controlled contact force; shielding

records.Mechanism: junction heating changes wavelength, output, responsivity and alignment
records.Geometry Variables: die placement; spreader; optical path; package CTE
records.State Variables: T; optical spectrum/power; V/I; stress; alignment
records.Potential Useful Coupling: temperature sensing/control can stabilize optical output
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: wavelength drift; efficiency loss; misalignment; accelerated aging
records.Design Rule: close electrical-thermal-optical loop at operating power
records.Mitigation / Control: spreader; thermal control; low-CTE datum; derating

records.Mechanism: mount strain, preload, CTE or vibration shifts sensor output
records.Geometry Variables: mount points; adhesive; cavity; membrane; CTE; orientation
records.Potential Useful Coupling: structural strain can be intentional measurand when calibrated
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: offset/drift/hysteresis from package rather than target
records.Higher-Order Trigger: output residual correlates with package state
records.Design Rule: separate intended measurand path from package stress paths
records.Mitigation / Control: compliant mount; symmetry; isolation; calibration field

records.Mechanism: contact compliance, friction and clearance accumulate through transmission stages
records.Geometry Variables: gear/screw/bearing positions; preload; lubrication; surface finish
records.State Variables: torque; angle; contact pressure; friction; wear; T; cycles
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: backlash; heat; wear; stick-slip; efficiency loss
records.Design Rule: no zero-backlash/life claim without tolerance, lubrication and cycle evidence
records.Mitigation / Control: preload; lubrication; hardening/finish; replaceable wear parts

records.Mechanism: pressure drives flow/permeation through gaps/material while chemistry changes seal properties
records.Geometry Variables: groove/clearance; wall; path; surface; material pair
records.State Variables: pressure; leak rate; species; T; contact pressure; aging
records.Higher-Order Trigger: leak rises with chemistry/time beyond geometry model
records.Design Rule: seal material and geometry qualify together for exact fluid/environment
records.Mitigation / Control: double seal; backup; compatible material; drain/vent; inspection

records.Mechanism: sensor body/electrodes/optics perturb velocity, pressure, bubbles and boundary layer
records.Geometry Variables: probe intrusion; channel shape; upstream/downstream length; surface
records.State Variables: velocity; pressure; turbulence; concentration; sensor output
records.Potential Useful Coupling: sensor geometry can act as flow conditioner if validated
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: bias; pressure loss; bubble trapping; fouling
records.Higher-Order Trigger: calibration residual changes with installation geometry
records.Design Rule: calibrate sensor in its final local channel geometry
records.Mitigation / Control: flush sensing; conditioning lengths; bubble escape; geometry-specific calibration

records.Mechanism: trace species or surface residues alter electrode/membrane/catalyst response
records.Geometry Variables: surface area; porosity; coating; flow boundary; source-feed provenance
records.State Variables: concentration; current/potential; impedance; adsorption; T; t
records.Potential Useful Coupling: selective functionalization can increase target sensitivity
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: poisoning; drift; false response; irreversible fouling
records.Higher-Order Trigger: response drift not explained by target analyte/temp
records.Design Rule: Eco-Grex/recovered feed cannot enter sensing/catalysis without chemistry/contamination qualification
records.Mitigation / Control: barrier/cleaning; qualified coating; replaceable electrode; rejection

records.Mechanism: conductive shell blocks, redirects or becomes part of antenna current path
records.Geometry Variables: apertures; seams; shell curvature; antenna distance; grounding
records.State Variables: surface current; E/H; S-parameters; T; state
records.Potential Useful Coupling: shell may serve as ground/radiator/aperture if designed
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: detuning; nulls; trapped modes; EMI leakage
records.Design Rule: evaluate antenna on final body, seams and user/environment loading
records.Mitigation / Control: intentional aperture/ground; matching; isolation; seam bonding

records.Mechanism: emitted light/sound/heat interact with occupied/environmental boundary conditions
records.Geometry Variables: source position; surface temp; directionality; SPL; spectrum; distance
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: glare; hearing risk; heat/contact burn; nuisance
records.Higher-Order Trigger: claimed biological benefit beyond measured physical variable
records.Design Rule: optimize only measurable performance/comfort/exposure variables; no unvalidated biological resonance claims
records.Mitigation / Control: limits; shielding/baffles; power control; distance; duty cycle

records.Mechanism: burying functions shortens routes but reduces inspection/replacement access
records.Geometry Variables: access paths; module size; connectors; cavity; overmold depth
records.State Variables: fault state; MTTR; route lengths; thermal/EM parasitics
records.Potential Useful Coupling: replaceable functional islands can retain dense routed shell
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: single buried failure strands larger body
records.Design Rule: active/high-value/calibration-sensitive seeds default to replaceable islands until burial proven
records.Mitigation / Control: service cavities; test points; standardized ports; local isolation

records.Mechanism: later cure/sinter/solvent/laser/pressure step can damage inserted or earlier material
records.Geometry Variables: build order; distance; shield; tool path; atmosphere; thermal mass
records.Potential Useful Coupling: staged processing can protect sensitive functions and enable denser embedding
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: latent damage; drift; contamination; delam; warpage
records.Higher-Order Trigger: failure appears only after later process or aging
records.Design Rule: X→Y compatibility is directional and must include all later exposures
records.Validation Test: witness coupon + in-process readback + post-process functional/aging test
records.Mitigation / Control: reorder; local shield/sink; lower-temp route; insert later; encapsulate

records.Mechanism: sensor, network, compute and actuator delays interact with plant modes and protection timing
records.Geometry Variables: node placement; link path; delegated compute; sensor/actuator spacing
records.State Variables: latency; jitter; plant state; mode frequency; control state
records.Potential Useful Coupling: distributed CGX compute can coordinate thin endpoints when latency budget is closed
records.Primary Conflict / Parasitic: instability; stale command; unsafe delayed protection
records.Higher-Order Trigger: residual oscillation/fault timing not explained by nominal model
records.Design Rule: delegated compute is allowed only where worst-case latency/jitter preserves safe local fallback
records.Mitigation / Control: local C0 safe state; bounded leases; edge control; deterministic critical loops
